name: Grub
summary: East of the Crossroads, Grub feeds travelers from a hut shared with a cook and a baker. He teaches them to make stew from the Barrens' dig rats.

sections.title: A Frontier Appetite
sections.body: East of the Crossroads, Grub shares a hut with Duhng, his cook, and Tarban Hearthgrain, a baker. He puts the Barrens' dig rats to use instead of letting them go to waste. Travelers can learn his recipe for simmering the rodents into stew.

faq.answer: Grub is an orc who lives in a hut east of the Crossroads in the Barrens. He runs a small eatery there with Duhng, his cook, and Tarban Hearthgrain, a baker, serving travelers passing through.
Find Grub in a small hut at the foot of the mountains, just east of the Crossroads in the Barrens and off the main path.

faq.q: What does Grub need help with?
faq.answer: Grub needs travelers to gather dig rats from the Barrens for his Dig Rat Stew. He shares the recipe with cooks who prepare it.

angles.text: As a cook, you can learn Grub's Dig Rat Stew recipe by gathering its ingredients.
As Horde, you can find Grub's roadside kitchen just outside the Crossroads. There, he offers travelers food and a lesson in making use of what the plains provide.
